series.summary: On middle school graduation day, Rentaro Aijou confesses his love to his classmate Asakawa, only to suffer his 100th consecutive rejection. Utterly devastated, he decides to pray for a miracle at a matchmaking shrine.

segments.voiceover_text: On graduation day, Rentaro Aijou believes his cursed streak of bad luck is finally over.
He pours his heart out to his classmate Asakawa, only to receive the most brutal rejection of his life.
This devastating failure marks his one hundredth consecutive heartbreak since kindergarten, shattering his spirit.
His friends can only watch in disbelief, noting that nobody in history has ever suffered a hundred romantic rejections in a row.
Desperate for a miracle before high school begins, Rentaro visits a sacred matchmaking shrine to pray for love, completely unaware of the divine shock waiting for him.

series.summary: At the matchmaking shrine, the God of Love manifests before Rentaro with shocking news: due to a clerical mistake while watching anime, Rentaro is destined to meet one hundred soulmates in high school.

segments.voiceover_text: As Rentaro bows before the shrine altar, a blinding celestial light descends from the sky.
The God of Love manifests in person, declaring that he has arrived to answer Rentaro's prayers.
Consulting the sacred registry of fate, the deity reveals that every normal human is granted only one destined soulmate.
Yet Rentaro's destiny is shattered by an astronomical number: he will meet one hundred destined soulmates during high school.
The panicked god prostrates in apology, confessing he made a clerical error while watching anime—leaving Rentaro terrified of what will happen on his first morning of school.

parts.title: A Double Zing on Day One

series.summary: Rentaro begins his high school career and immediately locks eyes with two gorgeous classmates, Hakari and Karane. An electric shockwave strikes all three, sparking instant and overwhelming love.

segments.voiceover_text: Rentaro steps onto his new high school campus, praying the god's wild prophecy was just an absurd dream.
While crossing the entrance courtyard, he accidentally locks eyes with two gorgeous classmates, Hakari and Karane.
The instant their gazes meet, a violent romantic shockwave electrifies all three of their souls.
This is the legendary zing of destiny, sparking an uncontrollable passion that leaves Karane blushing furiously and Hakari starry-eyed.
Rentaro is struck with total panic: he has fallen madly in love with two different girls simultaneously, and neither girl has any intention of backing down.

parts.title: Competing Desires and the Double Confession

series.summary: Hakari and Karane actively compete for Rentaro's affection throughout the school day. At sunset, both girls summon Rentaro and independently confess their love to him.

segments.voiceover_text: With destiny pulling them together, Hakari and Karane immediately begin competing for Rentaro's undivided attention.
Karane attempts to maintain her tough facade, but melts into flustered stammering the second Rentaro looks her way.
Meanwhile, the sweet and alluring Hakari takes the offensive, offering homemade bento and feeding him with disarming sweetness.
Rentaro finds himself completely captivated by both girls, utterly unable to deny his genuine affection for either of them.
As the sun sets, both Hakari and Karane corner him to confess their undying love, leaving Rentaro terrified of the heartbreaking choice he must make.

parts.title: The Fatal Curse of Unreturned Love

series.summary: Rentaro rushes back to the shrine to ask the God of Love how to choose between his two soulmates, only to learn the horrific truth: if a destined soulmate is rejected, she will die.

segments.voiceover_text: Receiving two confessions from dream girls should be paradise, but for Rentaro, it feels like sheer torture.
Unable to bear crushing either girl's spirit, he sprints through the dark back to the sacred shrine.
He summons the God of Love, desperate for advice on how to choose between his two soulmates.
The deity's cheerful grin fades into grim gravity as he delivers a chilling warning.
The god reveals the horrifying truth: if any destined soulmate fails to find love with Rentaro, fatal misfortune will strike and she will die—leaving Rentaro only hours to save both girls.

series.summary: On the rooftop, Rentaro refuses to let either soulmate die. Falling into a desperate dogeza, he confesses his genuine love to both Hakari and Karane, proposing to date them both—a plea they shockingly accept.

segments.voiceover_text: With two innocent lives hanging in the balance, Rentaro meets Hakari and Karane on the rooftop at dawn.
Both girls wait with racing hearts, anxiously bracing for his final decision between them.
Refusing to let either girl die, Rentaro drops into a desperate dogeza, begging to date them both simultaneously.
Though stunned by his shameless proposal, both girls are deeply moved by his fierce honesty and boundless devotion.
Blushing through their tears, Hakari and Karane accept his outrageous plea, officially launching Rentaro's legendary journey with his first two loving girlfriends.
